page.layout: One printed page, full width: heading "DEDICATIO." at top centred; then running dedication text in paragraph form; then centred dedicatory signature lines (Reuerendiss. & Illustriss. / CELSITVDINIS T. / DEVOTVS / MELCHIOR HAIMINSFELDIVS GOLDASTVS, HELVETIVS.); signature mark "PAV" at lower right of text area. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: dixerim) virum graviorem, pleniorem officij, & bonorum studiosiorem non com-pererim. Hoc Principe, huius Consiliarius Res stat Moguntina, & vt proporro atque æternum felicitetur, id vero Deum Opt. Max. exsummis precibus veneror quæsoque. Cuius mei voti testes venire volo hos Scriptores, quos nunc C. T. more maiorum Do, Dico, Consecro, neque pariter cum illis, bene vertente Fauentiâ. Francoforducæ, 4. d. IV. NON. Septembr. A. N. C. CIↃ IↃCVI.

page.notes: The dedication's opening words are partly cut off at the top of the first line and are copied as legible. "Francoforduæ" and "Fauentiâ" are read as printed; the place name is doubtful. The date "CIↃ IↃCVI" reads MDCVI as printed, the scan being faint in places.
